blocks.prompt: 7 (i) A bag contains 8 red balls, 7 green balls. Find the total number of possible ways in which five balls are selected in a way: 3 red and 2 green.
blocks.explanation:
Bag mein se 5 balls nikalni hain: 8 red mein se 3 aur 7 green mein se 2. Kaunsi ball pehle nikli, is se farq nahi parta.
Find kya karna hai? Aise kitne selections mumkin hain.
Plan: \({}^{8}C_{3} \times {}^{7}C_{2}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 red, 7 green balls; 3 red aur 2 green chunni hain (kul \(3 + 2 = 5\)).
Humein find karna hai: tareeqon ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Har rang ka selection alag combination hai, kyunke balls ki tarteeb se farq nahi parta. Dono kaam saath hone hain ("and"), is liye fundamental principle of counting ke mutabiq multiply karenge.

Red balls chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{3} = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 56\]
Kyun: 8 red balls mein se 3 chunni hain; order ki ahmiyat nahi, is liye combination.

Green balls chunein
\[{}^{7}C_{2} = \dfrac{7 \cdot 6}{2 \cdot 1} = 21\]
Kyun: 7 green balls mein se 2 chunni hain.

Multiply karein
\[56 \times 21 = 1176\]
Kyun: Har red selection ko har green selection ke saath joda ja sakta hai, is liye dono ginti ko zarb diya.
Dhyan dein: Yahan jama karna ghalat hai; jama sirf tab jab do mein se koi ek surat ho.

Tasdeeq
\[1176 \div 21 = 56 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ulta divide karne par red wali ginti wapas mil gayi, yani multiplication sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 (ii) A bag contains 8 red balls, 7 green balls. Find the total number of possible ways in which five balls are selected in a way: 1 red and 4 green.
blocks.explanation:
Bag mein se 5 balls nikalni hain: 8 red mein se 1 aur 7 green mein se 4. Kaunsi ball pehle nikli, is se farq nahi parta.
Find kya karna hai? Aise kitne selections mumkin hain.
Plan: \({}^{8}C_{1} \times {}^{7}C_{4}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 red, 7 green balls; 1 red aur 4 green chunni hain (kul \(1 + 4 = 5\)).
Humein find karna hai: tareeqon ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Har rang ka selection alag combination hai, kyunke balls ki tarteeb se farq nahi parta. Dono kaam saath hone hain ("and"), is liye fundamental principle of counting ke mutabiq multiply karenge.

Red balls chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{1} = \dfrac{8}{1} = 8\]
Kyun: 8 red balls mein se 1 chunni hain; order ki ahmiyat nahi, is liye combination.

Green balls chunein
\[{}^{7}C_{4} = {}^{7}C_{3} = \dfrac{7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 35\]
Kyun: 7 green balls mein se 4 chunni hain. Yahan \({}^{7}C_{4} = {}^{7}C_{3}\) istemal kiya: 4 balls lena aur 3 balls chhorna ek hi baat hai, aur 3 factors ka hisaab chhota hai.

Multiply karein
\[8 \times 35 = 280\]
Kyun: Har red selection ko har green selection ke saath joda ja sakta hai, is liye dono ginti ko zarb diya.
Dhyan dein: Yahan jama karna ghalat hai; jama sirf tab jab do mein se koi ek surat ho.

Tasdeeq
\[280 \div 35 = 8 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ulta divide karne par red wali ginti wapas mil gayi, yani multiplication sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 (iii) A bag contains 8 red balls, 7 green balls. Find the total number of possible ways in which five balls are selected in a way: 4 red and 1 green.
blocks.explanation:
Bag mein se 5 balls nikalni hain: 8 red mein se 4 aur 7 green mein se 1. Kaunsi ball pehle nikli, is se farq nahi parta.
Find kya karna hai? Aise kitne selections mumkin hain.
Plan: \({}^{8}C_{4} \times {}^{7}C_{1}\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 red, 7 green balls; 4 red aur 1 green chunni hain (kul \(4 + 1 = 5\)).
Humein find karna hai: tareeqon ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: Har rang ka selection alag combination hai, kyunke balls ki tarteeb se farq nahi parta. Dono kaam saath hone hain ("and"), is liye fundamental principle of counting ke mutabiq multiply karenge.

Red balls chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{4} = \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6 \cdot 5}{4 \cdot 3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 70\]
Kyun: 8 red balls mein se 4 chunni hain; order ki ahmiyat nahi, is liye combination.

Green balls chunein
\[{}^{7}C_{1} = \dfrac{7}{1} = 7\]
Kyun: 7 green balls mein se 1 chunni hain.

Multiply karein
\[70 \times 7 = 490\]
Kyun: Har red selection ko har green selection ke saath joda ja sakta hai, is liye dono ginti ko zarb diya.
Dhyan dein: Yahan jama karna ghalat hai; jama sirf tab jab do mein se koi ek surat ho.

Tasdeeq
\[490 \div 7 = 70 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Ulta divide karne par red wali ginti wapas mil gayi, yani multiplication sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: 7 (iv) A bag contains 8 red balls, 7 green balls. Find the total number of possible ways in which five balls are selected in a way: All the red balls.
blocks.explanation:
Paanchon balls red honi chahiye, yani koi green ball nahi leni.
Find kya karna hai? 8 red balls mein se 5 chunne ke tareeqe.
Plan: \({}^{8}C_{5} \times {}^{7}C_{0}\), aur \({}^{7}C_{0} = 1\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: 8 red, 7 green; chuni gayi saari 5 balls red hain.
Humein find karna hai: tareeqon ki tadaad.
Tareeqa: 8 red mein se 5 chunein. Green ka hissa "7 mein se 0 chunna" hai, jo sirf ek tareeqe se hota hai: koi green na uthayein.

5 red balls chunein
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = {}^{8}C_{3}\]
\[= \dfrac{8 \cdot 7 \cdot 6}{3 \cdot 2 \cdot 1} = 56\]
Kyun: \({}^{n}C_{r} = {}^{n}C_{n-r}\) se kaam chhota ho jata hai: 5 factors ki jagah sirf 3. 5 balls uthana aur 3 balls chhorna ek hi faisla hai.

Green balls
\[{}^{7}C_{0} = 1\]
\[56 \times 1 = 56\]
Kyun: Corollary \({}^{n}C_{0} = 1\): kuch bhi na lene ka sirf ek hi tareeqa hai. Is liye green ka hissa jawab ko nahi badalta.
Dhyan dein: \({}^{7}C_{0}\) ko 0 samajhna aam ghalti hai; agar woh 0 hota to poora jawab 0 ho jata, jo ghalat hai.

Tasdeeq
\[{}^{8}C_{5} = \dfrac{8!}{5!\,3!} = \dfrac{40320}{120 \times 6} = 56 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Poora formula bhi wahi value deta hai.
